note: Unedited captures of the web app running locally in offline mode with the template generator and the default answer language (English). The parcels were drawn in the app on OpenStreetMap tiles (map labels are OpenStreetMap data); no weather or satellite data were fetched, so most inputs are missing. The answers are what the system produced in that state; they are not evaluation results. The sowing-date field is the browser's native date control and shows the regional date format of the capture machine. source_commit is the development commit of the client; client_files_sha256 is a digest over backend/src/smartagri/research_api/static/ (sorted relative path, NUL, sha256 of each file, newline) and can be recomputed from this repository.
